_note: Advisories npm audit may report without failing CI. Each entry is one advisory, with why it is accepted and a date after which CI fails again until someone re-checks it. Remove an entry when a fixed version is installed; an entry that no longer matches anything also fails CI.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS through crafted extglob patterns. Reaches the dashboard only through vite (build tool, dev dependency); patterns come from the project's own build config, not from users; picomatch is not in the built bundle and the runtime audit (--omit=dev) is clean. Every published version is affected (latest 4.0.7) and the only automated fix downgrades vite 8 to 6.
